name: remote-session-end-of-an-idle-session-is-silent
description: A remote session that has no turn in flight ends. Nothing observable changes: no transcript note, no status change. Another session's live turn is untouched.
reason: Claude sessions end on this machine all the time. Only a session PowerUp believed was working is worth a note, and one session ending must not clear another's turn.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'sessions we weren't tracking end silently'; AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.sessionEnd)
